title: High Tide CEO Discusses Q3 Results on The Dales Report
summary: Our Founder and CEO, Raj Grover, joined The Dales Report to break down High Tide’s record-breaking Q3, including $199M in revenue, $16.2M in Adjusted EBITDA and a record 10.2 tonnes distributed through Remexian in Germany.
body_markdown:
Our Founder and CEO, Raj Grover, joined The Dales Report to break down High Tide’s record-breaking Q3, including $199M in revenue, $16.2M in Adjusted EBITDA and a record 10.2 tonnes distributed through Remexian in Germany.
